findings_qualitative.value: alpha_CO anti-correlates most strongly with Ubar, Sigma_SFR and W_CO

evidence.quote: Among them, $\overline{U}$, $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}$, and integrated CO intensity ($W_\mathrm{CO}$) have the strongest anti-correlation with spatially resolved $\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$.

claims.hypothesis: alpha_CO decreases with stellar mass surface density at high Sigma_star
claims.experiment: Fit normalized alpha_CO vs Sigma_star above 100 Msun/pc2 for 29/25 galaxies
claims.finding: alpha_CO follows a negative power law in Sigma_star, insensitive to D/M

evidence.quote: The power-law index is insensitive to the assumed dust-to-metals ratio.

claims.hypothesis: alpha_CO depends on local conditions beyond metallicity
claims.result: Ubar, Sigma_SFR, W_CO strongest; metallicity correlation moderate to weak
claims.finding: Starburst-like conditions drive alpha_CO variation at 2 kpc

evidence.quote: We do not see a strong correlation coefficient between $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ and $12+\log({\rm O/H})$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Varying D/M toy model gives steeper indices (a = -0.74 and -0.47), so the relation is not caused by D/M variation

evidence.quote: these indices are steeper than our fiducial case

limitations_admitted.value: Data concentrated in narrow metallicity range 8.4-8.6, limiting metallicity analysis

evidence.quote: $>80\%$ of our data is concentrated in a small dynamic range of $8.4 \leq \ensuremath{12+\log({\rm O/H})}\leq 8.6$.
